name: SENSEI
summary: SENSEI uses single-electron-resolving Skipper CCDs to directly search for light dark matter, through Fermilab prototypes and an underground phase at SNOLAB.
detection_principle: Repeated nondestructive pixel measurements reduce electronic noise below one electron. Few-electron distributions are analyzed while controlling dark current, light leaks and radiation backgrounds.

key_parameters.name: Key capability
key_parameters.value: Pixel-by-pixel single-electron resolution; low readout noise is not equivalent to zero physical background.

results.summary: Underground Skipper-CCD low-mass dark-matter search limits were released.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
